race.comment: ERTIJAAJ (18) exciting mare who displayed a devastating turn of foot first up with the 60.5kg to score over 1300m in weaker grade at Rosehill. Heading in the right direction and is not here to make up the numbers. Genuine contender. CROSS TASMAN (3) ticks a few boxes third up despite drawing out. Produced excellent closing splits to finish a narrow second to Decorum with the 59kg from back in the field over 1400m at Rosehill. Can sit wide and put these away on his preferred conditions. MAN OF WORTH (15) handy fresh gelding resuming. Wasn't pushed out in the two trials and the booking of J Mac keeps him in the mix. RUINATION (19) comes out of the right race and expected to gain a start. Sat on the fast pace with a fighting third to Decorum over 1400m in a BM88 at Rosehill. Handles the conditions and sure to be around the money.
